title: Robert Schoch's solar flare and Lichtenberg figure idea

tellings.quote: but he thinks that the Giza plateau was hit by a solar flare

plain: A researcher named Robert Schoch is said to believe that the Giza plateau in Egypt, where the great pyramids stand, "was hit by a solar flare." The idea also involves Lichtenberg figures, the branching patterns that electrical discharges such as lightning leave behind. Geoffrey Drumm, a guest who talks about the pyramids, passes this on as Schoch's idea, which, if right, would mean a burst of energy from the sun once marked the site.
